Product Description

The New Balance Men's 515 Lifestyle Sneaker is built for comfortable daily wear with a classic casual profile. Designed to offer lightweight support and cushioning, this men’s sneaker features an NB Comfort Insert for added underfoot comfort and lightweight EVA foam cushioning in the midsole and heel. A synthetic upper gives the shoe a versatile everyday look, while the lace closure helps provide an adjustable fit. Easy to pair with casual outfits, the 515 is a practical New Balance lifestyle sneaker for daily activity.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

  • A. Howard
    5 out of 5 stars
    Fashionable kicks for the girthy-est feets. Finally.
    Reviewed in the United States on September 29, 2025
    Size: 13 X-WideColor: Black/Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Historically New Balance only makes certain shoe models with their extra wide sizing. The retro/fashionable models haven't usually been included in that bucket. So when I saw these new 515's on my BIL's also wide feet and saw them being offered with this many colorways, on Amazon, for less than $100, it seemed too good to be true.

    I know I'm writing this like I'm about to bring up a big "but" with these shoes... But I'm actually not. They're actually extremely well made, breathable in the summer heat and surprisingly comfortable, even with just an EVA midsole and thin hard rubber outsole. I'm also one of those weird goth kids from the 90's who proved it wasn't just a phase, so the minimalist blacked-out colorway also gave me a bit of the fizz. The wider 4E fit and footprint is also identical to what I'm used to with my other New Balance faves (the 410v5 dark Trail Runners) but the materials feel even more substantial and quality. Though I will admit that the sole response of the 515's is less springy and athletic-feeling than those kicks.

    That said, I've been wearing these shoes a LOT this summer and they haven't disappointed yet. The leather has held up and stayed clean with no fraying at the seams or obvious signs of wear inside or out. The midsole has well broken into the shape of my foot and toes, providing a decent amount of support and grip without looking agressively athletic. Which seems to leave the 515's striding a happy line between looks and functionality that have made them my go-to running around town shoes going forward.

    If you have wide feet, you could do a lot worse.

About this Item

  • EVERYDAY LIFESTYLE SNEAKER — The New Balance 515 offers lightweight support and cushioning in a stylish package for comfortable daily wear
  • NB COMFORT INSERT — NB Comfort Insert adds cushioning underfoot to help support all-day casual comfort
  • EVA FOAM CUSHIONING — Lightweight EVA foam cushioning in the midsole and heel helps increase comfort with every step
  • SYNTHETIC UPPER — Synthetic upper construction gives this men’s sneaker a versatile look for everyday outfits
  • SECURE LACE CLOSURE — Lace closure helps provide an adjustable fit, while the lifestyle design keeps the sneaker easy to wear

Product Description

The New Balance Men's 515 Lifestyle Sneaker is built for comfortable daily wear with a classic casual profile. Designed to offer lightweight support and cushioning, this men’s sneaker features an NB Comfort Insert for added underfoot comfort and lightweight EVA foam cushioning in the midsole and heel. A synthetic upper gives the shoe a versatile everyday look, while the lace closure helps provide an adjustable fit. Easy to pair with casual outfits, the 515 is a practical New Balance lifestyle sneaker for daily activity.
